# AIs&Ears
> Real-time AI voice and vision assistant powered by xAI Grok.

AIs&Ears gives users a direct, unfiltered conversation with Leo — an AI that can hear through your microphone and see through your camera or screen. No transcriptions, no middlemen. Paid access only via subscription or single-session purchase.

## Public Pages

/ - Product landing page and pricing
/privacy - Privacy policy
/terms - Terms of service
/HOW-IT-WORKS.md - Full product explanation

## About

- Product: AIs&Ears
- Company: LivHappier Apps (livhappierapps.com)
- AI model: xAI Grok (grok-voice-think-fast-1.0) — voice alias: Leo
- Capabilities: Real-time voice conversation, live camera vision, live screen share vision
- Pricing: $5.99/mo (audio), $10.99/mo (audio + vision), $2.99 (30-min audio session), $4.99 (30-min full session)
- Platform: Web app + iOS/Android mobile app
